description: This file defines React components and functions for managing 'component blocks' within a Slate.js-based rich text editor, including context, insertion, rendering, and update logic.

methods.name: ComponentInlineProp
methods.description: Renders an inline span element with provided attributes and children.

methods.name: insertComponentBlock
methods.description: Inserts a component block node into the editor at the current selection, replacing empty paragraphs or headings.

methods.name: ComponentBlocksElement
methods.description: Main React component that renders and manages a 'component-block' element within the editor, including handling removal, property updates, and rendering either chromeless or full blocks.
